verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent tracing and observability product, so capturing multimodal payloads in traces is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only describes generic capture of spans, LLM calls and tool calls (OpenTelemetry, SDK-level capture, bento.track_ai). Nothing documents capturing or rendering images, audio or file payloads inside traces.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
